📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type your text into the text area.
  2. Click "Calculate" to analyze it instantly.
  3. See words, characters, sentences and estimated syllables.
  4. Read the reading/speaking time estimates and the Flesch Reading Ease score with its grade label.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are syllables counted?

Syllables are estimated with a vowel-group heuristic ("beautiful" = 3). It is fast and usually close, but a real dictionary lookup would be exact — so scores are estimates.

What reading speeds are used?

Reading time assumes 200 words per minute (average silent reading) and speaking time assumes 130 words per minute (average speech pace).

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. All analysis runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to a server.
